name: APEFOODT (Asociación Peruana de Food Truck)

emails.reason: Published on the contact page; MX apefoodt.com (self-hosted).

name: Asociación Mexicana de Food Trucks
website_note: No website found; coverage is 2014-2016 press (Time Out México, Forbes MX, Expansión).

name: Food Truck Center Chile
website_note: Loads; a private Chilean food-truck services platform (academy, consultancy, event fleet coordination, marketplaces), not a municipal advisory group or association.

emails.reason: Published on the homepage; MX titan.email.

name: Hida Food Truck Association (飛騨フードトラック協会)
website_note: Loads; association for food trucks in the Hida region of Gifu, with a member list and event news.

notes: Newest news item is 'キッチンカー秋マルシェ2026' dated 2026-10-20 (event 21-23 Nov 2026 at Wood Forum Hida, ~20 trucks a day). No email or social links published.

name: Turnup Food Truck SA
website_note: Loads; a single food truck business (smash burgers, Johannesburg/Pretoria plus a Durban page), not a booking platform or vendor network.

emails.reason: Published on the contact page; MX tld-mx.com.

name: Asociación Argentina de Gastronomía Móvil (AsArGaM)
website_note: No website found; only 2015-2016 press (Perfil, Forbes Argentina, Ámbito, Cronista).
members_estimate: 400+ operators in Argentina (association figure, Cronista; not a membership count)
notes: Pushed the Nov 2016 law; Rodolfo Cámara named president/co-founder. No 2024+ evidence and no social accounts found.

name: Asociación Argentina de Food Trucks
notes: The list's '14-10-2026 Perfil article' is wrong: that Perfil piece is dated 19-10-2014 (the 2026 date is the page header). Newest mention of Ernesto Lanusse as president is El Sol, 1 Oct 2015.

name: Asociación Food Truck de la República Argentina (AFTRA)
notes: Only source is a 30 Jan 2020 Infogastronómica article naming Luis Defelipe (Food Truck Argentina S.A.) as Aftra president; he quit his own truck after 4 months in 2018. No social pages found.
